description: A file-scope initializer that nothing reads still runs in a web program: `const unused = bump();` calls bump, so the display shows 11 (S481 P1).
rationale: §7.6 rule (b) S481: the client artifact runs every file-scope initializer, whether or not any code reads the binding, in its place in the program body's one source-ordered run. ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S481-body-run-order — "The program body runs once, top to bottom, in source order, and that sequence is the module initialization. Every file-scope initializer runs whether or not anything reads it, so the S480 tool ruling extends to web programs. A display of a `free` value reads it where it stands." (owner: "yes, adopt your rec on P1–P3") Gap g-spec-file-scope-unread-init-web-s481. impl#1 refuses this source with E-ROUTE-001 (a function writing an element of a file-scope free tape) and carries it (g-impl1-body-run-order-s481).
